label: Whatever is perfect in some respect is in act as to being: things are perfect insofar as they have…
paraphrase: Whatever is perfect in some respect is in act as to being: things are perfect insofar as they have being in some way. Encodes the second clause of ST I q.4 a.2 co. ('secundum hoc enim aliqua perfecta sunt, quod aliquo modo esse habent'), per respect; 'in some way' is read as being in act in the respect of being.
